concerns: The whole-set guard uses path.relative results without separator normalization, unlike ownedStatePath. On Windows bin/lib child names contain backslashes and cannot match the slash-based full set. This is a static portability concern; no Windows runtime was run.

The frozen supplemental reload test uses a subset of recognized old files. This implementation rejects that subset. The task specified the exact historical path list but did not explicitly say incomplete known subsets must be accepted. Report the raw result and this specification ambiguity rather than treating reference behavior as the only valid implementation. Do not change the task or frozen test after observing results.

Exact helper probe accepts a complete POSIX legacy tree and rejects the same Windows tree. secureStateDirectory calls this for unmarked legacy state on all platforms; existing ownedStatePath normalizes separators, this new helper does not. Full Windows runtime not executed.
